ferramentas_texto.config_slide_dica: Edit dimensions, orientation and background of the current presentation.
ferramentas_texto.config_auto_dica: Replaces completed words using local rules while typing.
ferramentas_texto.config_capital_dica: Capitalizes the first letter of a sentence while typing.
ferramentas_texto.config_dicionario_dica: Look up words and add terms to the personal dictionary.
ferramentas_texto.config_glossario_dica: Save exact translations between languages. Uses the local glossary only.
ferramentas_texto.config_mcp_dica: An MCP client can open, inspect and edit local presentations. Run this command from the repository root or configure the featherslide-mcp executable in the client (stdio transport).
ferramentas_texto.config_mcp_estado: The server uses a separate session. Connection to the document open in the interface is not integrated yet.
ferramentas_texto.diagrama_dica: Select the number or edit the text to show actions. Indentation shows the level. Apply updates the drawing.
ferramentas_texto.nao_reconhecida: Word not recognized. Suggestions are not definitions.
ferramentas_texto.sobre_idioma: The primary language determines suggestion order. Other enabled languages are also accepted.
ferramentas_texto.sobre_traducao: Exact translation of registered expressions. Add a language pair and translation; unrestricted sentences require an offline model.
ferramentas_texto.sobre_sinonimos: Local Portuguese vocabulary. Separate alternatives with semicolons.
ferramentas_texto.indisponivel: Dictionary unavailable or loading. Install one in Review → Language and try again.
ferramentas_texto.confirmar: Click an alternative to replace the selected passage. Check the context before applying.
ferramentas_texto.sem_resultado: No local match. Add a rule below.
ferramentas_texto.uma_palavra: AutoCorrect accepts one word without spaces or punctuation.
ferramentas_texto.aguarde: Enter a word and wait for the dictionary to load.
ferramentas_texto.texto_mudou: Text changed. Close and reopen the panel to select again.
ferramentas_texto.selecione: Select a passage or text box and reopen the panel.

arquivo.confirmar_descartar: There are unsaved changes. Discard them?

erros.motor_desatualizado: Outdated engine: missing {lista}. Rebuild the application.

inicio.subtitulo: Presentations that stay on your machine.
inicio.nota: Presentations are .fsdz files on your computer; it also opens .pptx (PowerPoint, Google Slides) and .odp (LibreOffice). Nothing leaves the machine.

config.idioma_dica: Changes the language of the whole interface immediately.

apresentar.fim: End of slide show. Click or press Esc to exit.

breve.exportar_pptx: save the presentation as .pptx to open in PowerPoint and Google Slides.
breve.exportar_pdf: a real PDF with one slide per page (the same page FeatherPDF will use).
breve.imprimir: print the slides, one per page or several per sheet, with or without notes.
breve.localizar: search for text in every slide and in the notes.
breve.ortografia: spell check with a local en-US/pt-BR dictionary, no network.
breve.temas: ready-made sets of colors, fonts and backgrounds for the whole presentation.
breve.variantes: color variations of the chosen theme.
breve.formatar_fundo: gradient or picture backgrounds, besides solid color.
breve.tabela: tables inside the slide, editable cell by cell.
breve.grafico: charts with their own data or linked to a FeatherSheet spreadsheet.
breve.icones: a library of vector icons to insert.
breve.wordart: decorated text with outline, shadow and fill.
breve.video: local video played during the slide show.
breve.audio: local audio played during the slide show.
breve.equacao: equations (the same formula engine as FeatherDocs).
breve.simbolo: insert symbols (arrows, Greek letters, math) in the text.
breve.link: links to websites or to another slide.
breve.data_hora: the date and time, fixed or updated on open.
breve.comentario: comments to review the presentation with other people.
breve.lista_marcadores: bulleted lists, with levels by Tab.
breve.entrelinha: the spacing between lines of text.
breve.colunas_texto: text in two or more columns inside the box.
breve.limpar: reset the text to the default style.
breve.agrupar: join elements to move and resize them as one.
breve.desagrupar: split a group back into loose elements.
breve.girar: rotate and flip elements (rotation is already in the file; the handle is missing).
breve.transicao_nenhuma: moving from one slide to the next with no effect.
breve.transicao_esmaecer: a transition where the slide fades out and the next fades in.
breve.transicao_deslizar: a transition where the next slide slides in.
breve.transicao_empurrar: a transition where the next slide pushes the current one.
breve.transicao_revelar: a transition where the current slide moves away revealing the next.
breve.transicao_todos: use the same transition on every slide.
breve.animacao_aparecer: an element that appears on click.
breve.animacao_voar: an element that flies in from one side.
breve.animacao_zoom: an element that grows to its size.
breve.painel_animacao: the list of the slide's animations, in order.
breve.animacao_ordem: change the order of the animations.
breve.modo_apresentador: a window with the next slide, the notes and a clock, while the audience sees only the slide.
breve.ensaiar: time each slide so the show runs by itself.
breve.gravar_apresentacao: record narration together with the slides.
breve.classificacao: every slide in a grid, to reorder by dragging.
breve.modo_leitura: the slide show inside the window, without full screen.
breve.regua: rulers above and beside the slide.
breve.guias: guides that elements snap to while dragging.

introducoes.uso: FeatherSlide is a presentation program that runs entirely on your machine: no account, no login, none of your content leaves it. Here is how to use each part, from creating slides to presenting in full screen. Follow in order with the arrow, or pick a topic in the side menu.
introducoes.atalhos: The keys that make the work faster. Slide and element keys work with the slide in focus; file and window keys work anywhere.

corpo: On the home page, choose New presentation or Open. A new presentation starts with a title slide.
• The slide panel is on the left; the slide being edited in the middle; the speaker notes below.
• The ribbon on top has the Home, Insert, Design, Transitions, Animations, Slide Show and View tabs. Double-click a tab (or Ctrl+F1) to swap the ribbon for menus.
• Commands marked "Coming soon" do not work yet: each tooltip says what it will do.
New slide (Ctrl+M) adds a Title and content slide after the current one; the button arrow picks another layout.
• Layout changes the arrangement of the current slide and keeps the text already in the boxes.
• In the left panel: click to go to a slide, drag to reorder, right-click to duplicate, delete or hide.
• A hidden slide stays in the file, but the slide show skips it.
Click an element to select it; Shift+click adds another; dragging on the background selects what ends up inside.
• Drag to move; the corner and side handles resize. The arrow keys move 1 pt (10 pt with Shift).
• Delete removes, Ctrl+D duplicates, Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V copy and paste with the style.
• Arrange brings to front or sends to back and aligns on the slide.
Double-click a box (or press Enter with it selected) to type. Esc or a click outside finishes.
• Empty layout boxes show a gray hint that does not appear in the slide show.
• Font, size, color, bold, italic, underline and alignment apply to all the text of the selected box.
Insert → Shapes puts a rectangle, ellipse, triangle, arrow or line in the middle of the slide.
• Fill and Outline (Home → Drawing) pick the colors; Weight, the outline thickness.
• Insert → Image embeds the image in the presentation: the .fsdz carries it along.
F5 starts from the first slide; Shift+F5, from the current slide.
• Advance with →, Space, Enter or a click; go back with ← or Backspace. Home and End go to the first and the last.
• Esc leaves the slide show.
The presentation is saved as .fsdz: a container with the slides in Arrow columns and the images as files.

• Open also reads .pptx (PowerPoint and Google Slides) and .odp (LibreOffice Impress): slides, boxes, shapes, images, background and notes. On save, the presentation becomes .fsdz (the original is not touched).
• Ctrl+S saves to the same file; Ctrl+Shift+S asks where.
• In the browser (development mode), Save downloads the file.
The gear in the top corner opens Settings: theme, color scheme, accent color, language and shortcuts.
• F12 opens the Monitor: memory, processor and graphics card, the console and the metrics of each engine command.

teclas.zoomAjustar: Fit the slide to the window

memoria.indisponivel: Measurement unavailable (installed app on Linux only).

total.dica: Memory of all the app's processes, added up

principal.dica: The main process: the engine and the files

webview.dica: The interface process: the drawing on screen and JavaScript

pico.dica: The highest use since the app opened (VmHWM)

cpu.dica: The app tree's processor use, in % of one core (the ceiling is 100 % × {nucleos} cores)

gpu.dica: How much of the time the graphics card was busy (whole system, not just the app)

vram.dica: Graphics card memory in use on the system

overlay.vazio: No log recorded or matching the filter.
